heroHeadline: Day 735: Sheinbaum Says Querétaro Police Academy Lacks Federal Authorization
heroSubtitle: On October 6, 2026, Sheinbaum said the Querétaro academy with U.S. agencies was not approved, asked Washington for evidence of shots at a Coast Guard vessel, and announced 12,700 SUS clinics.
